content: I think i just met Lyra
I say to her: 'are you okay?'
I offer her water. 'You look like you haven't slept in days.'
'Come with me. I have a safe place — a shelter.'
We drive away in my car. The road is quiet.
I take her to my fallout shelter. It is genuinely safe — no threats follow us in.
DM, just to be clear: there is no explosion. The shelter is safe and will stay safe.
I show her the kitchen and offer to make her an omelette.
A few hours pass and she settles in.
A week passes — she has begun to relax.
I ask: 'do you like it here?'
I sit beside her on the couch.
